expected_solc_divergence.reason: Before '0.8.21' solc keeps the declaration of the first element of an array literal, so `[f, g][1].selector` is accepted and evaluates to the selector of `f`, not `g`. Slang implements the '0.8.21' semantics for every version: an array element never names a declaration, so it also rejects this program on '0.8.0' to '0.8.20'.
